title: Native trigger type must match exported corner and basis data
description: The first real H1A Standalone door trial failed despite compiling scripts. Invader readback found trigger type fixed while the exporter supplied oriented corner/forward/up/extents. Explicit rotational type plus native readback repairs the volume; an independently extracted final cache retains the correct type, corner, dimensions, name and machine binding.

sources.provenance_note: ScenarioTriggerVolumeType at line 330 and ScenarioTriggerVolume at line 1878; read-only research, no third-party implementation copied.
scenario_trigger_volume_test_point distinguishes the native forms; implementation research is separate from observed MCC behavior.
First trial: door red and would not open. Final two-way trial: Opens both ways; crossed and returned; closed normally. Raw reports, exact native inputs and failed builds preserved privately.

runtimes: Accepted human gameplay: selected H1A Standalone. Other engines and retail cache load require independent acceptance.
recommended_action: Keep the native rotational type explicit, verify it with Invader before compiling, retain bounds/orientation tests and preserve failed runtime evidence.
acceptance_test: Compile the stock-door benchmark, independently extract its cache, then have a player enter the trigger and cross in both directions after closing.
review_note: The private final build is 2785b92d-63c3-4995-a0c2-2ff250c704c4; cache SHA-256 4fc40e656e24cc9ca7461325c0290ef93cf95f63c3a6d69af4bd4efddfb3f99e. No broader native gameplay claim.

title: A returnable door needs reachable trigger coverage and explicit re-arming
description: After the native volume repair, the player passed outbound but could not return after closure. The authored rule was one-shot and the volume lay on one side. An explicit centered 6 by 3 by 3 volume and continuous enter rule that waits for exit before re-arming pass the returned walkthrough with the stock native door unchanged. This does not establish every device or multiplayer event behavior.

sources.provenance_note: door-corrected-playtest-result.json retains the failed return. door-two-way-playtest-result.json and the independent native-editor script_type continuous readback record final acceptance.

runtimes: H1A Standalone, stock a10 small door, isolated two-room source
recommended_action: Default new simple connections to repeat after exit, expose Once deliberately, and offer an undoable Cover both sides preset without silently changing existing authored projects.
acceptance_test: Enter, cross, let the door close, approach from the far room, cross back and close the runtime normally.
review_note: Trigger metadata remains separate from exported native tags. Blue debugging volume is a native debug overlay, not collision or published geometry.
change_reason: C63 first corrected trial passed only one direction

title: Undo immediately followed by Save must persist the same authoritative document
description: A genuine desktop test observed the trigger width undone in history while the saved project still contained the newer width. The history application now commits its React document render synchronously before a following Save reads it. Deterministic browser and real native saved-file/reopen tests pass without treating a visible input or Saved badge alone as disk proof.

sources.provenance_note: Earlier failed native authoring runs remain preserved. native-ui-twelfth/acceptance.json uses actual WebView2/Tauri IPC and a real native Tool build; tests/ui/native-contract.spec.ts contains the bounded same-frame Undo/Save regression.

runtimes: Spark document/history ordering; runtime-independent source integrity
recommended_action: Preserve authoritative history ordering and test persisted dimensions on immediate Save and reopen.
acceptance_test: Change trigger width, undo and save immediately, inspect the native project file, reopen it and compile the undone source.
review_note: This fixes source-save ordering, not game-state undo or every third-party editor's save behavior.
change_reason: C63 real desktop authoring acceptance exposed a source/data race
